nom: medicube PDRN Pink Niacinamide Whip Cleanser

avis.texte: Previously used medicube aha bha cleanser till my skin started getting very dry. This cleanser fixed that problem in one wash. Highly recommend
This is the best cleanser I have ever used. It's nourishing, exfoliating and leaves my skin feeling so soft!

This cleanser is the BEST. Immediately after the 1st use I could tell my skin was softer than its ever been. Nice firming and softening cleanser that makes your makeup glide on perfectly! A must have! Definitely will repurchase!!!

Now this cleanser, when combined with a good exfoliator, has done something that no other cleanser has done before. It reduced my PMS-related acne. I would get them under my nose and above my lip, in my eyebrows, on my jawline, etc. It was the kind of acne you could only get relief from by popping it. But with this, my skin hasn't had bad acne ever since. Get this stuff, and it's sensory heaven for your hands and face.
